policy: Never replace these checkpoint-bound baseline measurements with the first evaluation from a new training run. proxy_metric_keys are explicitly approximate, single-environment values and must not be treated as four-env maxima.

reference.velocity_frame: source heading frame; not fixed episode-start frame

provenance.trace_binding: Source trace filename and internal teacher/iteration match the exact evaluation; trace has no embedded checkpoint SHA

missing_metrics: Four-environment full-rate maximum_cross_track_m absent; reference contains clearly marked single-environment trace proxy
Four-environment full-rate max_abs_final_heading_deg absent; reference contains clearly marked single-environment trace proxy
Four-environment full-rate max_turn_radius_m absent; reference contains clearly marked single-environment trace proxy

source_evaluation.reset: reference_phase0 plus seeded uniform joint perturbation +/-0.005rad; reserved environments never used by optimizer
source_evaluation.step_scope: Observed normal-force contact onset; not yet genuine-air-step acceptance
source_evaluation.acceptance_scope: preliminary: four held-out envs, 16 seconds; not hardware validation
source_evaluation.plateau_definition: five fixed-seed evaluations, physical score range <0.01; no automatic stopping or curriculum change

trace_metrics.scope: one saved evaluation environment, 10 Hz; not the four-environment maximum
trace_metrics.initial_root_basis: source reference phase-zero root transform, as used by source reset
trace_metrics.heading_definition: unwrapped quaternion heading from phase-zero root; sparse yaw-rate integral reported separately
limitations: Trace records only the first of four evaluation environments.
Samples run from 0.02 to 15.92 seconds, so maxima and the last 80 ms may be missed.
Quaternion net heading differs from an Euler/world angular-z integral when the torso rolls or pitches.
